'''Bellano''' is a fishmonger who appears at the [[Montelli Quarter]] marketplace. He has a soft spot for cats.

He can be seen talking with [[Sofia]] from 6:00 AM to 11:59 AM and talking with [[Aleksander]] from 6:00 PM to 10:59 PM.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;<nowiki>(6:00 AM to 1:59 PM)</nowiki>
:'''Bellano:''' Fresh catch from Riccioli!
:'''Bellano:''' Whadda Crab, Coconut Urchin, Rainbow Dolphinfish, Titanium Mackerel, you name it!
----
;<nowiki>(2:00 PM to 4:59 PM)</nowiki>
:'''Bellano:''' Look who it is, my little glutton!
:'''Bellano:''' You're always around when there's fresh fish.
:'''Bellano:''' Go ahead and dig in! If you can make it to the Riccioli Islands, you'll be in for a real treat.
:'''Bellano:''' Too bad I'm getting old and can't catch any big fish anymore.
:'''Bellano:''' If I managed to hook a Fish King, all the cats in Ragunna would come running!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;<nowiki>(6:00 AM to 11:59 AM)</nowiki>
:'''Sofia:''' Hey, Bellano, can't you sell these [[Til the Fin-ish|two little fish]] separately?
:'''Bellano:''' No can do. Once these two fish start kissing, they're inseparable!
:'''Bellano:''' If you try to force them apart, the meat will instantly turn rancid.
:'''Sofia:''' ...I wonder if Riccioli is full of these strange creatures.
:'''Bellano:''' You know what? We used to call them "Die Hard Lovers!"
:'''Bellano:''' The longer they lock lips, the fresher and tastier the meat!
:'''Bellano:''' Then an Acolyte from the Order visited the island and thought the name was unseemly, so he renamed them with a more scholarly term.
:'''Sofia:''' What's it called now?
:'''Bellano:''' —"'Til the Fin-ish!"
:'''Sofia:''' Ha, what a poetic name. Makes them sound even more delicious.
----
;<nowiki>(6:00 PM to 10:59 PM)</nowiki>
:'''Aleksander:''' Mister Bellano, you leave me no choice—
:'''Bellano:''' You again! How many times must I tell you, no discounts!
:'''Bellano:''' Keep it up, and I'll call in the Order Tribunal's Acolytes!
:'''Aleksander:''' This is my cat, Aleksander II—come on! Say hello to the shopkeeper!
:'''Aleksander II:''' Me-ow!
:'''Bellano:''' ...
:'''Aleksander II:''' Purrrrrr...
:'''Bellano:''' ...Alright, fine, 20% off. No more.
:'''Aleksander:''' Hooray!
{{Dialogue End}}
